"Proud" is secondary to the active rejection of his view. Next time, I will assign the highest score (8-9) to **Resentful** to capture her moral indignation at his hypocrisy, lower **Defensive** to 2-3 (as she is countering, not cowering), set **Guilt** to 0, and keep **Proud** moderate (4-5) as a supporting state.
